purpose: Diagnose the exact proximal reason that the seven repaired Candidate58 Python cases with tentative preservation evidence remain C1-unsupported at WORLD_GUARD_EVAL_UNRESOLVED, without changing or rerunning C1 semantics.

population.selection_rule: From the immutable Gate2C2a repaired machine result, select every and only case whose language is python, tentative_kernel_prediction is E2_PREDICTED_PRESERVATION_EVIDENCE, and exact C1 reason is WORLD_GUARD_EVAL_UNRESOLVED:SYN-PY-01:effect.

allowed_inputs.machine_identity: Immutable Gate2C2a machine matrix and per-case c1_report/read_receipt only for population and SHA binding.
allowed_inputs.raw_source: Exact seven staged candidate Python source bytes reconstructed from the immutable materialized-cell tree and verified against each Gate2C2a candidate_source_sha256 before content analysis.
allowed_inputs.checker_input_surface: The exact certificate semantic_slice.source_contract and the exact execution_signature carried by the frozen adapter/certificate input for each selected case.
allowed_inputs.c1_code: Frozen C1 source code may be read as specification but may not be imported or invoked by the diagnostic analyzer.

forbidden_inputs: Gate2A/Gate2C2b truth labels or mutation operator metadata
Fresh-8 or any fresh real target

diagnostic_model.independent_reconstruction: stdlib Python ast only; do not import risu_e2_c1, repaired semantic engine, kernel, certificate producer, or C1 checker
primitive_checks: exact compare arity is one operator and one comparator
left raw-source origin resolves uniquely under signature source_roles and admitted straight-line prefix
right raw-source origin resolves uniquely under the same rules
effect-world role_values contains the exact left origin key
effect-world role_values contains the exact right origin key

taxonomy_semantics.TRACE_INPUT_INTEGRITY_FAILURE: Any source/certificate/matrix SHA or population binding fails.
taxonomy_semantics.COMPARE_SHAPE_UNRESOLVED: The frozen C1 world evaluator's one-op/one-comparator structural precondition is absent.
taxonomy_semantics.LEFT_ORIGIN_UNRESOLVED: Independent raw-AST provenance cannot derive the left guard origin in the admitted fragment.
taxonomy_semantics.LEFT_ORIGIN_NONUNIQUE: More than one semantic origin reaches the left guard operand.
taxonomy_semantics.RIGHT_ORIGIN_UNRESOLVED: Independent raw-AST provenance cannot derive the right guard origin.
taxonomy_semantics.RIGHT_ORIGIN_NONUNIQUE: More than one semantic origin reaches the right guard operand.
taxonomy_semantics.WORLD_ROLE_VALUE_MISSING_BOTH: Both uniquely reconstructed origin tokens are absent from the effect world's role_values.
taxonomy_semantics.WORLD_ROLE_VALUE_MISSING_LEFT: Only the left uniquely reconstructed origin token is absent from effect-world role_values.
taxonomy_semantics.WORLD_ROLE_VALUE_MISSING_RIGHT: Only the right uniquely reconstructed origin token is absent from effect-world role_values.
taxonomy_semantics.FROZEN_REASON_INCONSISTENT: All primitive prerequisites for evaluation are satisfied even though the immutable C1 reason says world evaluation was unresolved; this is fail-closed diagnostic inconsistency, not permission to promote.

causal_claim_boundary.allowed: State the earliest independently observed provenance/evaluation boundary corresponding to the frozen C1 failure for each of the seven cases.
forbidden: claiming a repair would make VALID_C1
claiming nonzero selective coverage would result
weakening C1 or treating primary semantic-slice results as independent proof

execution_contract.analyzer: stdlib-only and synthetic-qualified before first seven-source content read
execution_contract.synthetic_tests: exercise every taxonomy branch plus malformed/mismatched source hash, ambiguous origin, and a fully evaluable inconsistency control
execution_contract.real_execution: two deterministic replays over exact seven cases; exact logical byte identity required
execution_contract.archive: upload first-complete dual replay before repository result freeze
execution_contract.immutability: first complete Gate2C3 result may never be replaced; later diagnosis or remediation additive only
